name: lightpanda-browser
description: Search and render the public web or use explicitly shared, same-site browser sessions through bounded chat-scoped Lightpanda profiles.

LIGHTPANDA_BINARY.prompt: Optional absolute path to a Lightpanda binary. Defaults to the verified binary in the tool state directory.

TIMEOUT_MS.prompt: Maximum browser execution time in milliseconds.

MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES.prompt: Maximum UTF-8 output size returned by one operation.

SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS.prompt: Total deadline for one bounded public web search.

SEARCH_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES.prompt: Maximum response bytes accepted from one fixed search provider.

CAPTURE_MAX_BYTES.prompt: Maximum PNG bytes returned by one Lightpanda text-layout capture.

CAPTURE_MAX_WIDTH.prompt: Maximum text-layout capture width in pixels, capped at 1280.

CAPTURE_MAX_HEIGHT.prompt: Maximum text-layout capture height in pixels, capped at 4096.

OBEY_ROBOTS.prompt: Require anonymous Lightpanda browsing to obey robots.txt.

AUTHENTICATED_OBEY_ROBOTS.prompt: Apply robots.txt to explicit user-session browsing. Defaults to false; authentication, scope, and target validation still apply.

SESSION_TTL_MS.prompt: Idle lifetime of one temporary browser session in milliseconds.

MAX_SESSIONS.prompt: Maximum simultaneous temporary Lightpanda sessions for one chat.

IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.prompt: How long the chat-scoped daemon remains warm without jobs.
